money_model.finding: `amount` is DOLLARS PER POINT, not contracts. rPnL == (close-entry)*direction*amount, multiplier exactly 1.0 on all 69 non-degenerate rows.
money_model.first_model_was_wrong: An initial pass assumed amount==contracts at $2/pt and failed on 69 of 74 rows, worst discrepancy $23,477. Recorded because the ledger was never wrong - the model was.

implied_contract_sizes.note: 42 rows sit at the frozen 15 contracts; 25 at 17; 2 at 20. The ledger spans more than one sizing regime, so no per-trade dollar figure here may be normalised to 15.

stop_analysis.CORRECTION_2026_08_21: My published verdict was WRONG and the operator's screenshots exposed it. I wrote 'UNSUPPORTED - the file records no stop prices' because initialSL is empty on all 74 rows. That was true of the FIELD and false of the FILE. A stop-out is recorded by its MONEY, not by a stop-price column: realized PnL of exactly -517.50 at exactly 17.25 points on 15 contracts IS the frozen stop. I read one column, found it empty, and published an absence.
stop_analysis.relayed_claim_was_7: The relayed figure was 7. MEASURED: 4. The relayed claim is REFUTED on count, but its substance - that exact 17.25-point stops exist in this ledger - is CONFIRMED. My earlier 'UNSUPPORTED' was the worse error of the two.

7_exact_17_25_stops.verdict: SUBSTANCE CONFIRMED, COUNT REFUTED - 4 stop-outs at exactly 17.25 points / -$517.50, derived from realized PnL because initialSL is empty. My earlier verdict of UNSUPPORTED is RETRACTED.
